texts.text: H. H7 core block with audio in fitted; every port leaves on the right
I. Input: 6.35 mm springs to the ADC through 3.3k; 3.5 mm via its NC contacts; R103 DNP
R. Bypass: rest passes IN_TIP through R113 100R / R114 1k; energised LINE_L via R121 100R to the tips, LINE_R via R122 560R to the 3.5 mm ring; U7 (Section=hp_out) DNP
P. Pot scan: U101 channels 0-4 SIZE, PITCH, DENSITY, POSITION, MIX into PC0; 5-15 tied to GND; U101 on 3V3A with 100 nF and 2.2 uF; 100 nF at each wiper
B. TAP, FREEZE, BYPASS buttons, each lit; chain TAP-FREEZE-BYPASS
E. Encoder and D. display socket
5V_PRODUCT: barrel J106 via U103; the block's U2 prefers it over USB.
W. Barrel 9-12 V either polarity: D105 SMBJ15CA, Q102/Q103 AO4606 bridge (R115-R118, D106-D109), U103 AP63205 5.0 V
S. ESD: D110/D111 on EFF, D112/D113 on IN at J104, D114/D115 on OUT at J103/J105. J105 balanced: R119 47R, R120 620R
